# LAB-121 question 1

## Who asked

The judge of `code_review` workflow run `20261007T125021Z-5b8557`, item
5#2 ("Whether an abandoned run counts as \"has not finished\" and should
be refused"), ruled `owner`.

## Question

Question: does "a run that has not finished" include abandoned runs (never finished, no longer owned)? Option A: keep the current reading and copy abandoned runs as they were left (the current code, test and SKILL.md). Option B: refuse abandoned runs before writing anything, which changes plan, its test, and the caller documentation.
